Guidance & outlook: If we go by the guidance given in the beginning of the current financial year, we have surpassed most of the guidance, like Deposit growth, we were at 11.28% against the guidance given 10 to 12%.
Same way, in credit growth, our growth is 21% plus against the guidance of 12 to 14%.

So, we expect that now we have repriced all the deposits, and with the support of all other products, we will maintain the cost of funds as well. − And then NIM will automatically… since, we have not given any guidance, but yes, in NIM we have given guidance of 2.8 to 2.9, and we have reached 3.05% with the support of lower cost of funds.
Growth & demand: This growth comes to 15.53% year -on-year growth in June, supported by Advances growth of 21.18% and Deposit growth of 11.28%.

So thereby our total Advances, global Advances have reached to 272,768 crores and Deposits have reached 3,32,315 crores. − Deposit growth has been supported by CASA growth where our growth year - on-year has been 12.34%.

Even though we take the base to higher Page | 12 level going forward, I expect that around 30% growth in Vehicle Loan can be maintained, even if with a higher base, and 20 to 25% growth can be maintained in Home Loans because the demand is there and we can continue that. − And then MSMEs, of course, is a new sector where we see good growth.
Margins & costs: This Operating Profit growth has been supported by core income growth where our NII income has grown by 16.85%.
1,018 crores; that has also supported us in our Operating Profit growth.
We have given guidance to maintain the credit cost below 0.75% against which in the 1 st Quarter, our annualized credit cost is 0.39%.
Capex & expansion: Whereas, the charges and commission from other sources that has increased by some 70% YoY.

Balance sheet & cash: And because of various channels, other channels, other than the deposits, like we are raising funds through borrowing, through refinance, through other channels, so ou r cost of funds that has improved in the last quarter, I think that will also be remaining stable at that level only.
As in the last quarter, we have done certain reclassification of Deposits and borrowings.
And our overall cost of funds has even declined with the support of lower cost on the borrowings.
